t02.why: Ridgeway meets Reading in a jog: an east leg and a west leg 26.7 m apart (OSM shows both). The old picks pair 22-69's east leg (0.4 m from OSM's east crossing) with 22-68's west leg (4.6 m from OSM's west crossing). Like legs agree: east-east 4.9 m, west-west 5.4 m.

t04.why: The same jog as tie 2: the old picks pair 22-69's east leg with 22-66's west leg (1.0 m from OSM's west crossing). Like legs agree: east-east 8.0-8.3 m, west-west 8.7 m.

t12.why: Montgomery Road and Clarion Avenue meet in a jog: two crossings 12.9 m apart (OSM shows both). 22-70 shows one leg (0.5 m from its OSM crossing); 22-75's old pick is the other leg (its west arm, 1.7 m from the other OSM crossing). The re-readers on 22-75 took the middle of the jog, which agrees with 22-70 within 2.9 m by chance, so the rule's (a) is set aside: the like legs are 5.8-6.8 m apart, the paired unlike legs 12-14 m.

t13.why: Both plates show Brewster meeting Montgomery in a jog, and both readers took the middle of it (16.8 m apart). The old picks are each plate's image-west leg; 22-69's is 1.0 m from the one OSM crossing, 22-75's 17.1 m from it. Pairing 22-69's leg with 22-75's other leg gives 7.9-8.7 m, so this is probably the jog again (b), but 22-75's other leg is estimated from the readers' midpoint, not read. Kept in the rerun.

t01.why: Both re-reads on 22-67 repeat the old reading (where the diagonal avenue merges into the north-south avenue), 25.6 m from 22-69's five-way point and 29.6 m from OSM's Gilbert/Woodburn crossing. Neither name is printed in 22-67's region. Further north on 22-67, where Hewitt and the 'MONT.' branch leave the same avenue (y about 135-180), the avenue sits 4.3-13 m from 22-69's point and 5-11 m from OSM: probably the junction is mis-identified on 22-67, but that is not a read. Needs a targeted read of the Gilbert / Woodburn / Montgomery / Hewitt junction on 22-67.

t08.why: One reader finds no Geringer/Groub crossing on either half (Groub ends at Ralston); the other reads it, at low confidence, through a 7 m gap north of Ralston. Both halves' old picks and the re-read are the same point on paper (37L and 37R overlap at the gutter: 37L x = 37R x + 5633), so the 24 m measures the two halves' models, not the picks. The name pairing is doubtful but the tie is one paper point.

t11.why: Neither name is printed in either region. On 22-66 the two reads of the same T (a street printed 'ST.' ending on the avenue with the car tracks, its north side cut by the plate edge) differ by 62 px. On 22-69 one reader finds no Wehrman; the other reads, at low confidence, a street printed 'AVE.' meeting Gilbert (6.3 or 18.2 m from the two 22-66 reads). OSM has no Wehrman/Gilbert crossing. Name match unconfirmed.
